lines.text: # A fresh worktree often starts on the shell's default Node, which is older than .nvmrc.
printf 'Node %s is active; rerunning on Node %s from .nvmrc with fnm.\n' "$have" "$want" >&2
die "Node $have is active, but VitaDeck needs Node $want (.nvmrc). Run fnm use or nvm use, then rerun."
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "Docker daemon not running; start Docker Desktop and rerun scripts/agent-check.sh full."
die "Neither docker compose nor docker-compose is available."
$compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake -S . -B out-vita && cmake --build out-vita"
docker compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake -S . -B out-vita && cmake --build out-vita"
# Fails install on a Node older than engines.node in package.json instead of failing later in tsc.

- Node.js 24.16+ (`.nvmrc`; `fnm use` picks it up) and pnpm (pinned by `packageManager` in `js/package.json`). `pnpm --dir js install` once. Older Node bundles a corepack that cannot launch pnpm 11+ and fails with `Cannot find module .../bin/pnpm.cjs`.

- Node.js 24.16+ (`.nvmrc`; `fnm use` picks it up, and `scripts/agent-check.sh` switches to it through fnm on its own) and pnpm (pinned by `packageManager` in `js/package.json`). `pnpm --dir js install` once. Older Node bundles a corepack that cannot launch pnpm 11+ and fails with `Cannot find module .../bin/pnpm.cjs`.

- Host build needs CMake, raylib 5.5, curl, OpenSSL, zlib (`brew install raylib` on macOS; raylib + OpenGL/X11 dev packages on Linux). On Linux/GCC configure with `CC=gcc CXX=g++ cmake -S . -B out -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group"`.
- Vita build and Linux smoke run in Docker. Start Docker Desktop first.

files.patch:
diff --git a/scripts/agent-check.sh b/scripts/agent-check.sh
index 9034780..2676817 100755
--- a/scripts/agent-check.sh
+++ b/scripts/agent-check.sh
@@ -25,6 +25,23 @@ die() {
     exit 1
 }
 
+# A fresh worktree often starts on the shell's default Node, which is older than .nvmrc.
+use_pinned_node() {
+    want=$(cat .nvmrc)
+    have=$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
+    [ "$have" = "$want" ] && return
+    if [ -z "${VITADECK_PINNED_NODE:-}" ] && command -v fnm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        printf 'Node %s is active; rerunning on Node %s from .nvmrc with fnm.\n' "$have" "$want" >&2
+        VITADECK_PINNED_NODE=1 exec fnm exec --using="$ROOT_DIR/.nvmrc" -- "$ROOT_DIR/scripts/agent-check.sh" "$@"
+    fi
+    die "Node $have is active, but VitaDeck needs Node $want (.nvmrc). Run fnm use or nvm use, then rerun."
+}
+
+install_js() {
+    step "Install JS dependencies"
+    pnpm --dir js install --frozen-lockfile
+}
+
 configure_host() {
     step "Configure host target"
     case "$(uname -s)" in
@@ -82,16 +108,13 @@ run_vita() {
     docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "Docker daemon not running; start Docker Desktop and rerun scripts/agent-check.sh full."
 
     step "Build Vita target"
-    if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-        compose="docker compose"
-    elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-        compose="docker-compose"
-    else
-        die "Neither docker compose nor docker-compose is available."
-    fi
-    $compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake -S . -B out-vita && cmake --build out-vita"
+    docker compose run --rm vitasdk bash -lc "cmake -S . -B out-vita && cmake --build out-vita"
 }
 
+case "${1:-fast}" in
+    fast | host | full) use_pinned_node "$@" ;;
+esac
+
 case "${1:-fast}" in
     fast)
         run_fast
